candidates.opening:
About the role
Auspro is seeking a suitably qualified and experienced Engineering Draftsperson to join our engineering team. The role involves preparing detailed engineering drawings and documentation to support infrastructure and construction projects, including roads, drainage, and subdivisions.
Key responsibilities
- Prepare detailed engineering drawings, plans, and layouts using CAD software
- Assist in the design and documentation of projects
- Interpret engineering sketches, specifications, and calculations
- Update and revise drawings based on design changes and project requirements
- Ensure drawings comply with Australian standards, codes, and regulations
- Liaise with engineers, surveyors, and project stakeholders as required
- Maintain accurate drawing registers and documentation records

candidates.opening:
WE'RE HIRING
Façade/Structural/Civil Design Engineer
Rickard Engineering – Melbourne
Significant project wins mean we are expanding our Melbourne team. We are looking for a well-credentialed and passionate engineer to join our company's office in Melbourne to work on projects both locally and internationally. The position involves the day-to-day work in a team of engineers under the supervision of our local Associate and Regional Manager. The role provides many exciting opportunities to work on interstate and international projects.
The Role offers the successful applicant a wide variety of opportunities and duties, including:
• Designing, planning, organising, and overseeing the construction of façade/structural/civil engineering projects.
• Reviewing, checking, and interpreting all drawings, instructions, and documentation received from either the Client or other authorities.
• Complyi
key_lines: • Overseeing and mentoring junior staff and liaising with a variety of stakeholders including builders, architects, subcontractors, other consultants and suppliers.
Qualifications, Skills, and Experience:
• Tertiary Engineering Qualification in Façade/Structural/Civil Engineering.
• Experience (2+ years) in façade engineering.
• Experience in the design of steel/concrete structures.
• Experience using engineering software, including STRAND7, Robot, THERM, and AutoCAD (or similar software).
• Experience and efficiency in Microsoft Office/365 Suite required.
• Working rights in Australia are required.
Only applicants required for an interview will be contacted.

RICKARD ENGINEERING is an established consultancy practice with over 30 years of experience in Australia, providing quality civil, structural and façade engineering services with 50% of work interstate/overseas. The practice is involved in a number of landmark projects in Australia and worldwide: North America, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and Oceania. The head office in Australia is located in Sydney, with offices/representatives in Melbourne (Australia), Denver (US), Shanghai (China), Dubai (UAE), London (UK), and Ho Chi Minh City (Vietnam).
